The data coordination task was focused on data collection, data governance, data management, evaluation plan, and the intellectual property plan. The data collection activities included understanding the specific data elements that the project needs to capture for the various DER devices and the metering requirements including measurement devices, sensors, and other data sources. The data governance discussions covered data quality, reliability, compliance, security, data gaps, and/or issue identification/resolution. The team also recognized the need for developing processes for storing, organizing, accessing, and processing data. Included as part of the data coordination task are the Intellectual Property Plan and the Evaluation Plan. The Intellectual Property Plan was drafted for the project team in early July and circulated for review. There was feedback from the project team members requesting clarification on the intention of the Intellectual Property Plan. Once the DOE program manager’s input was provided, PacifiCorp recirculated the plan and received feedback and redlines to the plan from a number of project parties. The Intellectual Property Plan was completed on May 3, 2024. The initial draft of the Evaluation Plan was created in July 2023, and the project team conducted several working sessions to further define the grid services as part of the plan. Updated versions of the plan had been drafted and shared with LBL and the DOE. The latest draft was shared in June 2025 with feedback from LBL in August 2025.
